# Triumphant Barbering

> Precision fades by Vinnie based in Austin, Texas. Precision fades, tapers and beard work from Vinnie Molina in South Austin. Consistent, detailed and on time, which is why his clients keep coming back for years.

- Phone: (512) 923-9512
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Buda, Kyle, Del Valle, Manchaca, Mustang Ridge
- Google rating: 5.0 from 90 reviews
- Book an appointment (StyleSeat): https://www.styleseat.com/vinniemolina
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/triumphant-barbering/book.html

## Services
- Skin & bald fades: Blended clean from the skin up, high, mid or low. The razor fade takes it down with a hot towel and straight razor.
- Tapers: Low tapers and drop tapers that grow out clean and keep the neckline neat between visits.
- Textured crops: Scissor work on top, a fade underneath. Bring a photo of what you want, or let Vinnie pick what suits you.
- Beard trims & shape-ups: Beards shaped and blended into the fade so the whole look reads as one cut. Hot shaves too.
- Kids cuts: Parents trust Vinnie with their boys, including the thick and curly hair other shops struggle with.
- Curly & thick hair: Curls kept on top, faded clean on the sides, cut to work with the texture instead of against it.

## About
Triumphant Barbering is Vinnie Molina's shop at 9600 Old Lockhart Rd in South Austin. It is a one-barber operation, booked by appointment, so you get the same hands on your hair every visit. Inside it is red walls, palms, vintage maroon-and-white barber chairs and a framed boxing print. Vinnie cuts skin fades, tapers, textured crops and curly tops, and finishes beards so they blend right into the fade. His clients talk about the same things over and over: consistency, attention to detail and respect for their time. Some have been in his chair for six or seven years, plenty of dads bring their sons along, and he has more than 1,000 appointments booked on StyleSeat.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Yes. Triumphant Barbering is by appointment. Book a slot with Vinnie on StyleSeat, or call (512) 923-9512.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: A clipper cut and fade is $60 and a scissor cut and fade is $85, both with a straight razor line-up. The full menu with beard trims, hot shaves and early or late slots is on the Services page.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 9600 Old Lockhart Rd, Austin, TX 78747, in South Austin out past Onion Creek.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair, and curly hair?
  A: Yes. Parents bring their sons in regularly, first haircuts included, and curly or thick hair with a fade or taper is a big part of what Vinnie does.
- Q: Do you do beards and shaves?
  A: Yes. Beard trims blended into the fade, plus hot shaves and eyebrows.
- Q: What are the hours?
  A: Hours vary through the week and some days start as early as 5 AM. Before-6 AM and after-5 PM appointments are available, and the StyleSeat calendar always shows what is open.
